shortcuts.what: Roof pitch 6/12, with 6 in. overhangs at eaves and gables
shortcuts.why: not in the brief; the procedure says ask before assuming it, but nobody can answer inside this sub-agent run
shortcuts.effect: ridge height, roof area (1.61 sq) and the look of the roof all follow from it

shortcuts.what: Parts that rest on each other overlap by 2 mm (walls in the pad, studs in the siding, trim in the walls), so the wall object is 8 ft + 2 mm tall
shortcuts.why: touching faces would be coplanar, which qa_check reports; 2 mm is inside the 0.1 % tolerance of the 8 ft height, and walls-on-pad has its own 0.01 ft tol with a why
shortcuts.effect: none visible: the 2 mm is hidden inside the part below

shortcuts.what: Framing is bare studs: no bottom or top plates, headers, king, jack or cripple studs; studs that would stand in an opening are left out
shortcuts.why: the brief asks for studs at 16 in. on center for a later cutaway; plates and headers were not asked for and roughly double the parts
shortcuts.effect: a cutaway would show studs standing on the pad with nothing above the openings

shortcuts.what: Windows are a square frame with a meeting rail and two panes (no sash profiles, sill, locks or screens); the door is a flat slab with a round knob (no panels, hinges or threshold)
shortcuts.why: the brief names the parts but no window or door style; the hero is a whole-shed view
shortcuts.effect: reads as simple at a distance; looks plain closer than about 2 m

shortcuts.what: Shingles and lap siding are image textures with bump on flat surfaces: no shingle tabs or lap boards as geometry, no ridge cap, drip edge, fascia or soffit; the textures map in object space in the shader, so the UV maps do not carry them
shortcuts.why: the hero is a whole-shed view where 1/2 in. of relief does not show; a roofing-grade roof is the roof-blender job, not this pilot
shortcuts.effect: flat closer than about 2 m; an export to glTF or FBX would lose the siding and shingle pattern

shortcuts.what: Only the builder has looked: every look gate is my reading of Workbench review sheets and the Cycles render; nothing was opened in Blender's UI, rendered on a GPU, or judged by the user
shortcuts.why: cloud sub-agent session: pip bpy on the CPU, no user to ask
shortcuts.effect: colours, the sage tone and the overall look are unconfirmed; the GPU timing is unknown
